Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Off Calendar Jun-17-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for Default Prove-Up Hearing this day.
Dept. 218, Comm. William Gargano, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Lois Jones.
Elizabeth MacDonald, Esq. special appearance for Plaintiff: Chase Bank USA, N.A., a corporation.
Plaintifff's Witness: Paul Poliner was sworn and direct examined.
After hearing the testimony and evidence presented, the Court rules in favor of the Plaintiff and against the Defaulted Defendant: Mimi Wong as follows:
Damages $34,789.82
Prejudgment Interest $3,793.52
Costs $363.00, for a total of $38,946.34
Judgement signed in open court.
